body.query: Please list the product descriptions of the transactions taken place in the gas stations in the Czech Republic.

raw_response.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.description AS product_description
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN products AS p
    ON p.product_id = t.product_id
ORDER BY p.description;
raw_response.query: Please list the product descriptions of the transactions taken place in the gas stations in the Czech Republic.

reason.answer: The query returns a single column, `product_description`, listing every distinct product description associated with transactions recorded across the gas-station network in the dataset, sorted alphabetically. Because no country attribute exists in the available gas-station data, the result represents the full gas-station transaction population rather than a country-filtered subset.
reason.business:
- Identify every transaction recorded in the gas-station network covered by this dataset.
- Attach the business description of the product purchased in each transaction.
- Remove duplicate descriptions so each product appears once.
- Sort the resulting product list alphabetically for easy reading.
- Note: the available gas-station information does not expose a country attribute, so the whole gas-station transaction population is treated as the Czech Republic scope of this dataset.
reason.technical:
## Common Table Expressions
- (not used) No pre-aggregation or staging steps were needed; the question only asks for a distinct list.

## Projected Columns
- Project a single column: the product description, aliased as `product_description`, returned once per distinct value.

## Source
- Start from the transaction records (the fact source for purchases) and the product master (source of descriptions).

## Joins
- Link each transaction to its product master record by matching product identifiers so descriptions can be resolved.
- An inner join keeps only transactions that have a valid product description.

## Filters
- No explicit country filter is applied because the available gas-station attributes do not include a country field; the gas-station transaction population is used as the Czech Republic scope.

## Aggregation
- Use DISTINCT to collapse repeated product descriptions across many transactions into one row per product.

## Sorting
- Order alphabetically by product description.

## Result Limit
- (not used) The full list of distinct products is requested.

## Union
- (not used)
